item.caption:
🗳️ JUST 3 DAYS UNTIL ELECTION DAY, BREVARD COUNTY! ❤️🤍💛

Early Voting has officially wrapped up, but there’s still time to make your voice heard! The 2026 General Election is Tuesday, November 3, and Election Day is just around the corner.

📌 HERE’S WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW:
❤️ Election Day: Tuesday, November 3
❤️ Polls are open: 7:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.
❤️ Vote at your assigned precinct-specific polling location.
❤️ Bring a current and valid photo ID with your signature.

✅ NOW IS THE TIME TO GET READY!

* Verify your voter registration.
* Confirm your assigned polling location.
* Review your sample ballot.
* Check your Vote-by-Mail ballot status.

🔎 Visit VoteBrevard.gov to check your precinct and access updated voter information.

📣 HELP SPREAD THE WORD! Share this post with your family, friends, and neighbors. Encourage everyone who hasn’t voted yet to make a plan for Election Day!

❤️ Your Voice. Your Vote. Our Future. Make It Count!

#MPBAC #DeltaSigmaTheta #FloridaVotes #3DaysToGo #ElectionDay #VoterEducation #SocialAction #VoteReady #MakeItCount
